meta.homeTitle: Vinica – grapevine seedlings for your garden
meta.homeDescription: Grapevine seedlings adapted to the Baltic climate: table, wine and seedless varieties. Delivery via Omniva, LP Express parcel lockers and courier.
meta.catalogDescription: Choose grapevine seedlings: frost-hardy varieties tested in Lithuania. Filter by use, berry colour and ripening time.

info.aboutBody:
Vinica is a family nursery that has been growing grapes in Lithuania for over a decade. In that time we have trialled dozens of varieties and selected the ones that crop reliably in our climate without a greenhouse.

Every seedling we sell is raised in our own nursery from verified mother plants. Seedlings are sold with a strong root system, ready for planting.

Your success matters to us – every order includes growing instructions, and you can always write or call us with questions.
info.deliveryBody:
Orders are dispatched within 1–3 working days. We pack live plants with extra care – roots are wrapped in moist substrate and film, so seedlings handle the journey well.

Delivery options:
• Omniva parcel locker – €3.99
• LP Express parcel locker – €3.49
• Courier to your door – €5.99

Free shipping on orders over €60.

You can pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay – payments are securely processed by Stripe. Lithuanian bank payments are coming soon.
info.privacyBody:
We use your personal data (name, email, phone, delivery address) only to fulfil your order: to deliver goods, issue an invoice and send order-related information.

We do not share data with third parties except delivery services (Omniva, LP Express, couriers) and the payment processor (Stripe) – only as far as needed to fulfil the order.

You have the right to access, correct or delete your data – contact us by email. We only use essential cookies (to remember your cart and language).
info.termsBody:
1. Orders are accepted online around the clock. The contract is concluded at the moment of payment.

2. Prices are in euros, VAT included. Shipping cost is calculated at checkout.

3. Live plants come with a survival guarantee: if a seedling fails to take root within 30 days of delivery, we will replace it or refund you. Photos are required.

4. Returns: undamaged goods can be returned within 14 days. Live plants are returnable only for quality defects.

5. If you have questions, contact us – we reply within 1 working day.
